runtime_room_render_reference
Purpose: clean-buffer reference for the $1516 room-tile renderer and $1F19/$1EC8 fill scans, suitable for port renderer regression tests.
Original authority: $14B9 packed room decoder, $1516 playfield draw order, $0EFE generated tile-class writer, $1D85 object pointer math, $1F19/$1EC8 fill scans, and $0DBF level-modulo fill pattern copy.
Scope: this is not a full gameplay frame; it intentionally excludes status panel, player, targets, enemies, shots, palette, and later XOR sprite draws.

screen_address_formulas
$0EFE tile dest: $3000 + $0280*Y + $18*X + $08, then 24 contiguous bytes are written.
$1D85 object pointer used by fill probes: $3000 + $0140*(objectY & $FE) + $08*objectX.
$1516 major room nibbles draw at X=0,5,10,15,20,25 and Y=3,8,13,18,23,28.
Room-nibble bit 1 draws class $3 across the four vertical gap cells below that nibble; bit 3 draws class $C across the four horizontal gap columns to the right on the second pass.
$1F19 scans the just-finished major column; $1EC8 scans each horizontal gap column. Both are gated by $0760[room] and copy one of four $07A0 fill patterns selected by $0BB6 & 3.

port_rules
Use the digest table as a byte-level reference for clean room rendering before adding status/player/object layers.
Preserve the $1516 draw order, including class-0 clear writes, because later draws and fill scans observe the current screen bytes.
Preserve $0760 room gating and $0BB6 & 3 fill-pattern selection; do not bake the fill output into room nibbles or tile-class names.
